Title: Azure Logic Apps (Standard): Upgrade to Node 18 LTS by 11 September 2023

Body.Content:
Support for Node 16 LTS is ending on 11 September 2023. Any application hosted on Azure Logic Apps that relies on this version will not be supported and must be upgraded to Node 18 LTS by 11 September 2023. 

Any Azure Logic Apps instance created after September 11 will automatically default to version 18. 

Required action 

To mitigate potential downtime and exposure to security vulnerabilities, upgrade to Node version 18 before 11 September 2023. Here's how: 

  1. Access the settings for your Logic App. 

  1. Navigate to the Configuration section. 

  1. Locate the WEBSITE_NODE_DEFAULT_VERSION setting and modify the value to 18. 

Help and support 

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.
